Officer's narrative
Officer narrative: Responding to a reprot of a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, I found Driver 2's vehicle with its
rear bumper pushed into the trunk area of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 2 stated that the collision happened as described,
and that account matches what the witnesses and the photographs show. Driver 1 also confirmed the sequence of
events.
Passenger was reported as being in Driver 1's vehicle and complained of pain in the left knee. However, both
witnesses and I observed that Passenger was not inside the vehicle when the collision occurred. It is not yet clear
whether the knee injury resulted from this crash.
Some damage to Driver 1's vehicle appears to be older. A few scratches along the rear quarter panel may predate
this collision, and it is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact. Driver 1 is named on the policy
covering the vehicle. No citations were issued at the scene. Further follow-up is recommended to determine the
extent of injuries and vehicle damage.
